title: Israel launches Operation Rising Lion with strikes on Iranian nuclear and military sites
body:
On 13 June 2025 Israel launched Operation Rising Lion, a large-scale attack on Iran's nuclear facilities, military sites and top commanders. Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu said the aim was to roll back the Iranian threat to Israel's survival by preventing Iran from building nuclear weapons, and that the attack would last for as many days as it takes. He alleged Iran had enough enriched uranium for nine nuclear bombs. The International Atomic Energy Agency had said Iran was in breach of its non-proliferation obligations for the first time in almost twenty years.

Strikes hit locations in Tehran and nuclear, military and air defence sites across the country. An Israeli military spokesperson said the Natanz enrichment site was significantly damaged, a claim the Council on Foreign Relations noted had not been independently verified. Iranian state media reported that Maj. Gen. Mohammad Bagheri, Maj. Gen. Hossein Salami, Brig. Gen. Amir Ali Hajizadeh and Maj. Gen. Gholam Ali Rashid were killed, and the Tasnim news agency reported that at least six nuclear scientists died, including former Atomic Energy Organization head Fereydoun Abbasi.

Iran launched about one hundred drones, which Israel said were intercepted outside its airspace, and then fired dozens of ballistic missiles. Supreme Leader Ali Khamenei promised harsh punishment, and Foreign Minister Abbas Araghchi called the attack a declaration of war. Iranian state media said Iran would no longer take part in nuclear talks scheduled in Oman for 15 June. US Secretary of State Marco Rubio said the United States was not involved in the operation. The UN Security Council held an emergency briefing at Iran's request.
